title.en_US: Vinput 2.3.8 — arm64 release artifacts and optional clipboard
title.zh_CN: Vinput 2.3.8 — arm64 发布包与可选剪贴板依赖

text.en_US: Release tarballs and Debian packages now ship for both x86_64 and arm64. The clipboard addon is now optional: vinput loads even when clipboard history is disabled, and clipboard-based insertion degrades gracefully at runtime. sherpa-onnx has been bumped to v1.13.5.
text.zh_CN: 发布包（tar.gz 与 Debian 包）现在同时提供 x86_64 与 arm64 架构。clipboard 依赖改为可选：即使禁用剪贴板历史，vinput 也能正常加载，基于剪贴板的插入会在运行时优雅降级。sherpa-onnx 已更新至 v1.13.5。
